theme: An open day in Dubrovnik before Saturday's charter.
greeting: The calendar's clear today, Dan — no meetings, just Dubrovnik and two days until the boat. Good time to close the handful of things that get harder once you lose signal underway.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat day-of logistics
needsAttention.detail: The hotel's booked, but the Sept 19 marina transfer, an early-afternoon bag hold, and the pre-dawn Sept 20 checkout for a 7:30 flight all still need arranging — and all from shore before Saturday, since the charter has little signal.

needsAttention.title: Reach the Nautilus instructor
needsAttention.detail: Still open: confirm Saturday's boarding time and place and set up the Sept 19 return airport transfer — better closed while you're ashore than once you're underway.

needsAttention.title: Book the Florida rental car outright
needsAttention.detail: No longer a hedge — a Full-Size SUV at Tampa for Sept 20 to Oct 5, so you're not stuck at walk-up rates jet-lagged on a Sunday landing.

flagged.title: A personal note from EqualityMaine
flagged.detail: A heartfelt message about a leadership transition and moving on, addressed to you directly — worth a warm reply when you're back on shore.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — Expedia, HBO Max, Rancho Gordo, Nextdoor, a couple of campaign asks.

recipe.title: Grilled quail with braised chestnuts & kabocha squash
recipe.why: Autumn's first squash and chestnuts are coming into the markets now, worth building a meal around.

tasks.title: Book St Pete lodging for the Sept 20-22 landing gap
Pre-boarding shopping in Dubrovnik - cash, snacks, provisions

acts.line: Nothing scheduled — a rare fully open day ashore in Dubrovnik.
A good stretch for errands that get harder once you're underway.
The charter boards Saturday; tonight the shore still has good signal.
